class.name: GodotPhysXMotorcycleProbe
class.brief_description: Internal test bridge for a PhysX two-wheel vehicle.
class.description: Creates a two-wheel direct-drive PxVehicle2 vehicle and drives it from a script, so a script-side lean controller can be tested. PhysX has no built-in balance for two-wheelers; [method apply_torque_impulse] and [method set_angular_velocity] let a script keep the bike upright. For games use [PhysXMotorcycle3D]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal test class of the PhysX module, not a stable API: it may change or be removed without notice.

method.name: apply_torque_impulse
method.description: Applies a torque [param impulse] in world space to the chassis this tick.

method.name: get_actor_position
method.description: Returns the world position of the chassis actor's origin.

method.name: get_angular_velocity
method.description: Returns the chassis's angular velocity in world space.

method.name: get_forward
method.description: Returns the chassis's forward direction in world space.

method.name: get_forward_speed
method.description: Returns the speed along the chassis's forward axis, in m/s.

method.name: get_linear_velocity
method.description: Returns the chassis's linear velocity in world space.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the chassis position in world space.

method.name: get_roll_angle
method.description: Returns the lean angle around the forward axis, in radians; positive when leaning right.

method.name: get_up
method.description: Returns the chassis's up direction in world space.

method.name: get_wheel_jounce
method.description: Returns how far the suspension of wheel [param wheel] (0 front, 1 rear) is compressed.

method.name: get_wheel_separation
method.description: Returns the distance between wheel [param wheel] and the ground; negative when it penetrates the ground.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Creates the motorcycle at [param position] in the PhysX physics [param space]. Returns [code]true[/code] on success.

method.name: set_angular_velocity
method.description: Overrides the chassis's angular velocity. A lean controller that blends the roll component toward a target stays stable where torque impulses can diverge.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs the vehicle simulation for [param dt] seconds with [param throttle] and [param brake] in [code][0, 1][/code] and [param steer] in [code][-1, 1][/code]. Call it before each physics step.
